title.narrative: Advancing media pluralism in the Eastern Partnership and wider civic engagement in Belarus

description.narrative: In line with EED¿s mission and goals, the action¿s overall objective is to contribute to democratisation in the EU¿s Eastern Neighbourhood. This action is expected to help diversify the sources of independent media in the Eastern Neighbourhood countries (Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, the Republic of Moldova and Ukraine) and increase the number of reliable, fact-based and balanced media sources.
